{"code": "from scipy.stats import chi2

# Compute chi-square for site and severity imbalances

# Site
site_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['site'])
expected_site = np.outer(site_ct.sum(axis=1), site_ct.sum(axis=0)) / site_ct.sum().sum()
chi2_site = np.sum((site_ct - expected_site)**2 / expected_site)

# Severity
severity_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
expected_severity = np.outer(severity_ct.sum(axis=1), severity_ct.sum(axis=0)) / severity_ct.sum().sum()
chi2_sev = np.sum((severity_ct - expected_severity)**2 / expected_severity)

# Calculate p-values
p_site = 1 - chi2.cdf(chi2_site, df=2)
p_sev = 1 - chi2.cdf(chi2_sev, df=2)

print(f'Site chi2: {chi2_site:.4f}, p-value: {p_site:.4f}')
print(f'Severity chi2: {chi2_sev:.4f}, p-value: {p_sev:.4f}')"}
